title: Product base change for open immersions with invertible torsion coefficients
author: The Stacks Project Authors
difficulty_reason: The proof must handle an arbitrary nonsmooth product factor, so smooth base change alone is insufficient. A minimal-dimensional counterexample is forced onto closed points by strict-henselian dimension reduction; projective compactification and the one-proper-factor Kunneth formula then annihilate its cone.
